duquesne-incline.name: Duquesne Incline
duquesne-incline.price_text: ≈ $2.50–3 one way, cash preferred; check on the day
duquesne-incline.hours: Daily, roughly 05:30–00:30 · check on the day
duquesne-incline.tip: Ride up near sunset and walk down the wooden steps or take the car back for the best skyline view.

point-state-park.name: Point State Park
point-state-park.tip: Stand at the fountain where the three rivers meet, then look for the old Fort Pitt blockhouse.
point-state-park.best: Morning or early evening in summer

allegheny-river.name: Allegheny River
allegheny-river.price_text: Free to walk; boat tours cost extra
allegheny-river.tip: Walk the North Shore trail for river and skyline views, and watch the rowers in the morning.

cmu.name: Carnegie Mellon University
cmu.hours: Campus grounds open daily; buildings vary
cmu.tip: Walk the grassy Cut between the buildings for the classic campus photo.

carnegie-museum.name: Carnegie Museum of Natural History
carnegie-museum.hours: Usually Tue–Sun, closed Monday · check on the day
carnegie-museum.tip: See the dinosaur skeletons first, then the minerals hall if you have time.

kennywood.name: Kennywood
kennywood.price_text: ≈ $45–70 day ticket; check current price online
kennywood.hours: Seasonal, roughly May–Oct · check on the day
kennywood.tip: Go on a weekday and ride the old wooden coasters early before lines build.

pitt.name: University of Pittsburgh
pitt.price_text: Free to walk; Cathedral of Learning tours may cost
pitt.hours: Campus open daily; Cathedral lobby on weekdays
pitt.tip: Look up in the Cathedral of Learning's 42-storey lobby, then find the nationality rooms if open.

strip-market.name: Strip District food market
strip-market.price_text: Free to browse; food costs vary
strip-market.hours: Best Sat morning; many shops close early afternoon
strip-market.tip: Come hungry on a Saturday morning for the street food and old-style grocery shops.

mt-washington-view.name: Mount Washington overlook
mt-washington-view.tip: The Grandview overlook gives the postcard view of the three rivers and the stadiums.

gateway-clipper.name: Gateway Clipper river cruise
gateway-clipper.price_text: ≈ $20–30 sightseeing cruise; check on the day
gateway-clipper.hours: Seasonal sailings, mostly daytime and evening
gateway-clipper.tip: A short cruise is an easy way to see the skyline from the water without much walking.

phipps.name: Phipps Conservatory
phipps.hours: Daily, roughly 09:30–17:00 · check on the day
phipps.tip: Good rainy-day stop; the glasshouse rooms are warm, so dress in layers.
phipps.best: Any time; quieter on weekday mornings

andy-warhol.name: The Andy Warhol Museum
andy-warhol.hours: Usually Tue–Sun, closed Monday · check on the day
andy-warhol.tip: Start at the top floor and work down; allow at least two hours.

north-shore-walk.name: North Shore riverfront walk
north-shore-walk.tip: Walk between the stadiums and the fountain for river views and public art.

primanti.name: Primanti Bros. sandwich
primanti.hours: Daily, long hours · check on the day
primanti.tip: Order the classic sandwich with fries and slaw inside the bread — that is the local way.

south-side-walk.name: South Side East Carson Street walk
south-side-walk.tip: Walk the old commercial street by day for shops and bars, and avoid late weekend nights if you want quiet.

heinz-history.name: Senator John Heinz History Center
heinz-history.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
heinz-history.tip: Good for Pittsburgh history and the local sports exhibits on a rainy day.

cathedral-learning.name: Cathedral of Learning nationality rooms
cathedral-learning.hours: Weekday tours, limited hours · check on the day
cathedral-learning.tip: Book a guided tour to see the decorated nationality rooms inside the tower.

squirrel-hill.name: Squirrel Hill neighbourhood walk
squirrel-hill.price_text: Free to walk; food costs vary
squirrel-hill.hours: Always open; shops have daytime hours
squirrel-hill.tip: A good stop for lunch and a walk after the Oakland museums.

pnc-park.name: PNC Park baseball game
pnc-park.price_text: ≈ $15–60 depending on seat; check on the day
pnc-park.tip: Sit on the river side for skyline views during the game.

market-square.name: Market Square
market-square.hours: Always open; restaurants have their own hours
market-square.tip: Central spot for a casual meal and people-watching downtown.
